title: Programme binding (.github/toolkit-programme.json)
description: Non-secret binding in a governed repository: the parent issue, record prefixes, the private state store and the checks that count as required. Repository identity comes from the origin remote and GitHub; this file must agree and cannot override it.

kind.description: The store backend. The only kind is github: a separate private repository written through the Contents API.

repository.description: A separate private repository; verified private and writable before every pass.

required_checks.description: Check names that count as required at the PR head, in addition to the checks GitHub marks required. With none of either, checks are never GREEN.

paid_security.description: The owner's answer, for a private repository, on GitHub's paid Secret Protection and Code Security (billed per active committer; need GitHub Team or Enterprise Cloud). off keeps them off; on lets Toolkit turn them on. Only the user's own answer is recorded, and only the binding merged on the default branch counts. The governance check reports a private repository without an answer. Public repositories get these features free and on by default.

dependency_updates.description: How Dependabot updates are merged. Setting auto_merge to patch-minor is the owner's standing permission for this repository: Dependabot patch and minor updates merge (merge commit) once every required check passes, and only while the default branch requires at least one check. Major updates, updates to a 0.x version, and updates someone else pushed to always wait for the owner. Only the binding merged on the default branch counts.

auto_merge.description: off (the default): every update waits for the owner. patch-minor: patch and minor updates merge on green.

github_actions.description: With auto_merge patch-minor: owner (the default) keeps GitHub Actions updates, which change workflow files, for the owner; auto-merge treats them like the rest.

projection.description: Where the Programme Graph goes on the parent issue page. Without it, the graph goes under the title. Child pages always put their block under the title and its marked note.

after_section.description: Heading text of the section the graph follows, for example CURRENT.

replace_section.description: Heading text of a hand-kept section the graph replaces when it is still on the page, for example Programme index. The section is removed in the same body write.
